question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Insipid
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Insipid"** means lacking flavor, vigor, or interest. (नीरस)

 
 
• **Example:** The soup was** insipid** and needed more seasoning to make it tasty.
 
 
 
• **"Tasteless"** refers to something that lacks flavor or excitement. (स्वादहीन)
 
 
• **Example:** The dish was completely **tasteless**, leaving us unsatisfied.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate synonym for **'insipid'** is **'tasteless'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Dismal** (उदास): Depressing or dreary.

 
 
• **Example:** The weather was dismal, making everyone feel gloomy.
 
 
 
• **Obscure** (अस्पष्ट): Not clear or hard to understand.
 
 
• **Example:** The poet's meaning was so obscure that we couldn't grasp it.
 
 
 
• **Idle** (बेकार): Not active or in use.
 
 
• **Example:** The machinery lay idle during the strike.
